notes: `upstream` is the base image the extended Dockerfile FROMs — the Isol8 fork (Isol8AI/agent) built from upstream OpenClaw 2026.7.2 (branch off tag v2026.7.2-beta.3 — 7.2 is BETA-ONLY upstream, no stable cut yet) plus the FOUR carried fork patches. Three are re-expressed onto 7.2's rewritten MCP manager (upstream #106359): bundled-MCP shared-runtime-scope (keys the static runtime on (workspaceDir, agentDir, configFingerprint) so sessions reuse one connected runtime — collapses the per-session EFS connect storm), non-blocking tool materialization (peek-then-warm; a cold catalog streams the run on built-ins and warms MCP in the background), and provider-agnostic size-based context pruning (Isol8AI/agent#1). The FOURTH, new in isol8.2, is the native workspace-seed boot hook: `ensureAgentWorkspace` converts an Isol8 sentinel `.openclaw/isol8-setup-seed.json` into native SQLite workspace-setup-state via OpenClaw's own `mergeWorkspaceSetupState`, then deletes the sentinel — so no legacy `workspace-state.json` is ever written and the #1429 "requires migration" brick class is structurally impossible. It is INERT when no sentinel exists (zero behavior change for existing containers), non-throwing (a failure logs and falls through to normal boot), and kill-switched by env `ISOL8_NATIVE_SETUP_SEED=0`. The 7.1 compaction aws-sdk-auth cherry-pick (openclaw#103638) was DROPPED — native in beta.3. REQUIRED to build the extended image FROM this fork tag, NOT vanilla ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw: config.py emits mcp.runtimeScope="shared" which only the shared-runtime-scope patch adds to the strict config schema (McpConfigSchema, relocated to zod-schema.root-support.ts in #106359, still `z.strictObject`) — a vanilla 7.2 base crash-loops every MCP owner and (via 7.x's fail-closed startup-migration checkpoint) fails the whole fleet closed. Tag scheme `<upstream-version>-isol8.<n>`. This is a PRIVATE GHCR package, only pulled by the authenticated build-openclaw-image.yml workflow. DEPLOY POSTURE: 7.2 is beta upstream. DEV rolled first; PROD was then promoted to the same extended image by explicit owner acceptance of beta-on-prod (2026-07-20), fleet force-updated onto it. `dev.tag` and `prod.tag` are both `2026.7.2-isol8.2-5fecaee` — an extended image built from the isol8.2 base (this re-bake adds the Paperclip skill's explicit-status guard: creating an issue WITH an assignee and no --status now sends status=backlog explicitly, so it cannot be silently promoted to todo and dispatch an agent run) (adds the native workspace-seed boot hook, INERT until a sentinel is written). It carries forward the `isol8-mail` skill (#1365) and the #1423 fix (Paperclip skill helpers use the absolute path `/app/skills/paperclip/scripts/paperclip-api.sh`, so agent kickoff task creation is deterministic instead of relying on a nondeterministic fallback). Both envs were pinned together on 2026-07-25 by explicit owner decision (prod has no users yet, so dev-first staging bought nothing over testing both at once). Watch for beta.3 runtime regressions (legacy memory-sidecar archive, channel inbound-dispatch contract, Paperclip heartbeat/abort); roll `prod.tag` back to `2026.7.1-isol8.2-3c1ebc0` if one surfaces. `image`/`tag`/`full` are the LEGACY PUBLIC upstream image (ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw): container-stack.ts uses `full` as the bootstrap/unknown-env fallback, pulled by per-user ECS tasks that carry NO registry credentials — so it must stay anonymously pullable and must NOT point at the private fork. `tag` also feeds the OPENCLAW_UPSTREAM_VERSION env-var fallback; keep it at the upstream version currently deployed (the `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` extended images, which drive meta.lastTouchedVersion, are the authoritative deployed baseline). `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev and prod (re-stamped by build-openclaw-image.yml on each base/extended build).
